planning.title: Guided Plan Generator
planning.description: Answer a few simple questions, and let AI craft a professional plan tailored for you based on your learning materials.
planning.step1_question: What type of plan would you like to generate?
planning.step2_question_audience: Who is the primary audience for this plan?
planning.step2_question_objective: What is the core objective you want to achieve with this plan?
planning.step3_question_tone: What is the desired tone of voice?
planning.step3_question_extra: Are there any additional formatting or content requirements?
planning.step4_question_workspace: Please select a workspace as the AI's knowledge source
planning.step3_question_outline: Please provide the content outline for the plan
planning.step3_placeholder_outline:
Optional. Provide a clear outline, and the AI will strictly follow your structure to fill in the content.
Example:
1. Introduction
   a. Research Background
   b. Research Questions
2. Literature Review
3. Data Analysis
4. Conclusion
planning.step3_placeholder_extra: Optional. E.g., must include specific data charts, cite no less than three references, etc.
planning.step4_question_word_count: What is the approximate total word count you expect for the report?
planning.saveDisabledTooltip: This plan was not generated from a specific workspace and cannot be saved as a note directly.
planning.step4_description: The AI will analyze all documents within this workspace to generate your plan. You can also choose not to use any workspace.
planning.noWorkspaceOption: Don't use any workspace (Use AI's general knowledge)
